description: A single conceptual schematic (no numeric axes, no scale bar) illustrating how inclusions evolve with Al content in Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel. A horizontal arrow at the bottom is labelled "Solidification process" (pointing right) and a vertical red dotted line is labelled "Liquidus", dividing the diagram into a pre-liquidus smelting region on the left and a solidification region on the right. Three blue dash-dot lines separate three lanes labelled, top to bottom, "1 wt% Al", "3 wt% Al" and "5 wt% Al". At the far left black angular/elongated particles are labelled "Al2O3". An implicit colour key in the header assigns light-grey shapes to "AlN", grey shapes to "MnS" and orange-brown shapes to "TiN". In each lane the individual Al2O3, AlN, MnS and TiN particles are drawn left of the Liquidus, and their post-solidification assemblies to the right. A dashed rectangle at the right highlights composite inclusions, in which a black Al2O3 core or a grey AlN/MnS body is overgrown by a later phase. The schematic's argument: as Al rises from 1 to 5 wt%, fewer single-particle Al2O3 form and heterogeneous nucleation yields Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS and TiN-MnS composites.

subfigures.description: Colour key and single-particle inclusions: black shapes labelled 'Al2O3' at the far left; header shows a light-grey shape labelled 'AlN', a grey shape labelled 'MnS' and an orange-brown shape labelled 'TiN'.

Top lane between the '1 wt% Al' and '3 wt% Al' dash-dot lines, bounded left by the red dotted 'Liquidus' line: large black Al2O3 particle on the left, and light-grey AlN, grey MnS and orange-brown TiN particles to the right of the Liquidus.
Middle lane labelled '3 wt% Al': a large light-grey elongated (bar-shaped) particle, a grey angular particle and an orange-brown TiN shape, with their post-solidification assemblies on the right.

Bottom lane labelled '5 wt% Al', directly above the 'Solidification process' arrow: grey rounded cluster, dark angular particle and an orange-brown curved shape, with assembled particles on the right.

Dashed rectangle enclosing composite/agglomerated inclusions, each combining a black Al2O3 core or grey AlN/MnS body with an overgrown second phase; no individual phase labels are printed inside the box.

observations.observation: The figure is a schematic diagram, not a micrograph or plot: its only axis is the bottom horizontal arrow labelled 'Solidification process' pointing to the right, and a vertical red dotted line labelled 'Liquidus' marks the smelting/solidification boundary.
Three horizontal lanes are labelled '1 wt% Al', '3 wt% Al' and '5 wt% Al' from top to bottom and are separated by blue dash-dot lines.
A colour key in the header maps a light-grey shape to 'AlN', a grey shape to 'MnS' and an orange-brown shape to 'TiN'.
Black angular and elongated particles at the far-left margin are labelled 'Al2O3', representing single-particle Al2O3 inclusions.
A dashed rectangle at the right of the diagram encloses composite inclusions formed after solidification, in which one phase encloses or is attached to another.
The largest black Al2O3 particle is drawn in the '1 wt% Al' lane, and the black Al2O3 particles become smaller/fewer in the '3 wt% Al' and '5 wt% Al' lanes.
The caption states the figure shows the evolution of inclusions during the smelting and solidification process in three samples.
The citing text states that AlN, MnS and TiN inclusions begin to precipitate during solidification in the order AlN > MnS > TiN.
The citing text states that a large number of single-particle Al2O3 inclusions form during smelting at 1% Al, and their amount decreases with increasing Al content in the 3% and 5% samples.
The citing text states that Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS and TiN-MnS composite inclusions were observed in solid steel, and that no Al2O3-AlN-MnS inclusions were observed in the 5% Al sample.

unreadable_items: No text labels are printed on the individual composite particles inside the dashed box, so their exact phase identities (Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS) are not confirmed by pixel labels.
The schematic has no numeric axis, scale bar or printed values, so no quantitative Al2O3/AlN/MnS/TiN fractions can be read from the figure.
